item.title: Major Traffic Measures Announced Ahead of A9 Dualling Works
item.description: A9 drivers face major traffic changes from January as a long term 40mph restriction and phased measures prepare the route for dualling works between Tay Crossing and Ballinluig, with officials urging caution and extra journey time during construction.The post Major Traffic Measures Announced Ahead of A9 Dualling Works appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Waits for New Visitor Levy Legislation Before Next Steps
item.description: Highland Council will wait for new legislation before deciding how a Visitor Levy might be designed, as councillors assess future charging models, local impacts and the potential to direct levy income toward projects that support communities and enhance visitor experiences.The post Highland Council Waits for New Visitor Levy Legislation Before Next Steps appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Jamie Stone Calls for Protection of Seasonal Work as Employment Rights Bill Advances
item.description: Jamie Stone is urging ministers to consult businesses that depend on seasonal labour as employment reforms progress, warning that new rules on flexible working and guaranteed hours could unintentionally harm rural industries across Caithness, Sutherland and Easter Ross.The post Jamie Stone Calls for Protection of Seasonal Work as Employment Rights Bill Advances appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Young Highland Broadcaster Shortlisted in International Radio Talent Search
item.description: A teenage presenter from Wester Ross is leading an international radio talent search, with Joshua Taylor’s rise highlighting the power of community broadcasting in the Highlands and the opportunities it creates for young voices to shine on a global stage.The post Young Highland Broadcaster Shortlisted in International Radio Talent Search appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland SNP Candidate Says Lords Appointments Show Misplaced Priorities
item.description: An SNP candidate in the Highlands has criticised new House of Lords appointments by Labour, the Liberal Democrats and the Conservatives, arguing they expose misplaced priorities at a time when households face rising costs and economic pressure.The post Highland SNP Candidate Says Lords Appointments Show Misplaced Priorities appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Electric Bus Trial Shows Promise and Limits on Shetland Roads
item.description: Shetland Islands Council says its first electric bus trial shows the technology can work locally, while highlighting cost, charging and winter performance challenges that must be addressed before any wider move toward low emission public transport.The post Electric Bus Trial Shows Promise and Limits on Shetland Roads appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Liberal Democrats Claim Momentum After Fort William By Election Victory
item.description: The Scottish Liberal Democrats have claimed momentum in the Highlands after winning the Fort William and Ardnamurchan by election, defeating the SNP and boosting confidence in a constituency currently held by Deputy First Minister Kate Forbes.The post Liberal Democrats Claim Momentum After Fort William By Election Victory appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Funding Boost Will Expand Mental Health Support for Scottish Veterans
item.description: Scottish Government funding will allow Combat Stress to expand specialist mental health support for veterans across Scotland, providing trauma focused treatment and virtual services ahead of the launch of a new national veterans mental health and wellbeing pathway.The post Funding Boost Will Expand Mental Health Support for Scottish Veterans appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Pròiseact-còmhnaidh Ùr do Dheugairean aig Fèisean nan Gàidheal, le Slàinte, Sunnd agus Fois A’ Gabhail Prìomhachas
item.description: A new Gaelic residential for high school pupils will launch in February 2026 at Dundreggan near Invermorriston, offering calm wellbeing focused days with cultural and creative activity, designed to help teenagers rest, reset and deepen their connection to Gaelic.The post Pròiseact-còmhnaidh Ùr do Dheugairean aig Fèisean nan Gàidheal, le Slàinte, Sunnd agus Fois A’ Gabhail Prìomhachas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Cold or Flu NHS 24 Shares Advice on Managing Symptoms Safely This Winter
item.description: NHS 24 is urging people to take care this winter as flu cases rise, sharing advice on spotting the difference between colds and flu, managing symptoms safely at home and knowing when to seek further medical help.The post Cold or Flu NHS 24 Shares Advice on Managing Symptoms Safely This Winter appeared first on The Highland Times.
